editorialDecl.p: The text of this file comes from the transcription campaign of the Inventaria project in Transkribus, where no page of it is marked done. It is therefore unrevised machine transcription and every reading is provisional. DoCTA has not read it against the facsimile either, and the DoCTA review status of a page is a separate axis recorded in the page register. The file is not a citable edition text. Transcription is diplomatic: the wording and spelling of the source are kept, nothing is normalised, expanded or corrected, and lineation follows the source, one lb per written line.
